svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 7 — Page 7 — "Full Dark" — Section 2 closes, operation begins
svg.desc: Page 7: 4 panels in 3 tiers (full widescreen / full / half-half). Section 2 closes. Full dark, twenty minutes to keeper's midnight round. The waterfront has become operating environment — black water, amber pools, lighthouse beam rotation. Squad in shadow of mooring bollard finalizes positions. Sable assigns roles, Wren strapped with the lens harness. Jink launches into the dark, dragonfly wings blazing emerald, banking over black water toward the lighthouse. Thresh takes overwatch at the pier base — weapon braced against tarred timber, white-knuckle grip, eyes wide, controlled fear holding her in position.
